sloka: त्वया मया च वैदेह्या लक्ष्मणेन सुमित्रया ।पितुर्नियोगे स्थातव्यमेष धर्मः सनाअनः ॥२-२१-४८॥
transliteration: tvayā mayā ca vaidehyā lakṣmaṇena sumitrayā ।piturniyoge sthātavyameṣa dharmaḥ sanāanaḥ ॥2-21-48॥

translations.english: You, Sita, Lakshmana, Sumitra and I -- all of us shall abide by the words of my father. This indeed is eternal law.
